integrity: The proof is analytic: it derives a competing-exponential representation, exact first and second moments, and a one-variable monotonicity reduction. The equal-rate specialization and limiting regimes are checked against the source. The 2026 primary paper and the 1999 predecessor were inspected in full; no finite simulation or inaccessible source is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is limited to two exponential full-load lifetimes with one common decelerating factor in the Li--Li load-sharing model. It establishes exact Pearson and Kendall rate-heterogeneity behavior but does not claim the same ordering for other dependence measures, nonexponential baselines, unequal decelerating factors, or multicomponent systems.
title: Rate heterogeneity weakens both Pearson and Kendall dependence in exponential load sharing
